  id = {EDN-73},
  title = {Hyperparameters change only under a written tuning protocol},
  note = {\textbf{Absorbs EDN-70} (2026-10-05): \texttt{n\_\allowbreak{}estimators} is a ceiling of 5,000, so early stopping decides the tree count.},
  date = {2026-10-05},
  milestone = {M3: Quality Assurance},
  topic = {Hyperparameter Tuning, Evaluation Protocol},
  participants = {@lukas2510},
  decision = {\texttt{learning\_\allowbreak{}rate} 0.05 and \texttt{num\_\allowbreak{}leaves} 63 stay, because a bounded sweep found no point that the validation split can tell apart from them.
A committed hyperparameter is replaced only under the protocol in the pipeline docs: selection on the validation split alone, by validation L1, and only when the simultaneous 95\,\% interval of the difference lies below zero.
\texttt{n\_\allowbreak{}estimators} is a ceiling of 5,000 with early stopping after 50 rounds.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item Adopt the point with the lowest validation L1: its gain lies inside the noise, so it would fail the protocol.
\item Pick by the test metrics that \texttt{dvc exp show} prints: leaks the test split into the model the gate judges.
\item Keep the ceiling at 1,000 trees: it ended both fits before early stopping could, so a parameter decided the tree count.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} Across the twelve points of the grid, no interval of the difference to the committed point lies below zero.
The interval is simultaneous because the best-looking of eleven noisy comparisons is the one most likely to look better than it is.
With the higher ceiling, the validation curve decides how many trees a model keeps.},
  ai = {Information seeking, Alternative generation, Alternative assessment, Recommendation, Solution generation},
  response = {Accepted with modifications},
  assessment = {AI designed the sweep, added the paired bootstrap grouped by seller, and stopped for the decision instead of committing a tuned value.
An independent AI review corrected the protocol: its first rule used an interval per point, which is not safe across eleven comparisons.
With simultaneous intervals the conclusion held.},
  aievidence = {Claude Code session of 2026-10-05 on issue \#64.},
  evidence = {``Tuning a hyperparameter'' in \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/docs/docs/pipeline.md}{the pipeline docs}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/reports/analysis/tuning_sweep_results.txt}{\texttt{tuning\_\allowbreak{}sweep\_\allowbreak{}results.\allowbreak{}txt}}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/reports/analysis/early_stopping_ceiling_results.txt}{\texttt{early\_\allowbreak{}stopping\_\allowbreak{}ceiling\_\allowbreak{}results.\allowbreak{}txt}}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/pull/77}{PR \#77}.},
